dev: zig build wasm && python3 -m http.server --directory docs 8080
firmware:build: cmake --build build-pico --target ggtag -j$(nproc 2>/dev/null || sysctl -n hw.ncpu 2>/dev/null || echo 4)
firmware:flash: DRIVE=$(find /run/media /media /Volumes -maxdepth 3 -name 'RPI-RP2' 2>/dev/null | head -1); [ -n "$DRIVE" ] || { echo 'ERROR: RPI-RP2 not found. Hold BOOTSEL and replug USB.'; exit 1; }; cp build-pico/ggtag.uf2 "$DRIVE/" && echo "Flashed build-pico/ggtag.uf2 to $DRIVE"
